intro.text: A romantic drama shown on hion viewers, about Sir Ashinata and Lady Hinobi, lovers kept apart because he is a ronin. Yumi and Nikaro watch its final episode together.
A historical romance shown on hion viewers in the evenings, set in an old-fashioned age and following Sir Ashinata and Lady Hinobi, lovers kept apart because he is a ronin.

description.text: It is Yumi's favourite programme and the most scandalous of the three she watches, and Nikaro also ranks it among the best.
The final episode ends sadly, after the couple share a kiss that shocks Yumi.
In what was meant to be the last episode, Ashinata tells Hinobi he must leave her for good because of a danger set loose by his dead, wicked brother. A surprise finale then brings him back to her.
Yumi and Nikaro miss the surprise finale, and Izzy tells them how it went. Some Dreamwatch members are watching the show when Nikaro calls at their Kilahito headquarters.
